other_conditions: Must be a bona fide resident of Odisha.
Must be a person with disability, irrespective of age and disability category.
Must not have previously availed the same services under the scheme.
Must have a disability severity of 40% or above for certification.

Eligible disability categories include: Acid Attack Victim, Autism Spectrum Disorder, Blindness, Cerebral Palsy, Chronic Neurological Conditions, Dwarfism, Hemophilia, Hearing Impairment, Intellectual Disability, Leprosy Cured Person, Locomotor Disability, Low-Vision, Mental Illness, Muscular Dystrophy, Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson’s Disease, Specific Learning Disabilities, Speech and Language Disability, Thalassemia, Sickle Cell Disease, and Multiple Disabilities.
benefits_summary: Provides rehabilitation support, aids/appliances, and social security services to persons with disabilities in Odisha.
